notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware run and no sim run was made. The card's entry symbol skill_aware_panda_gym.envs:PandaPushEnv was confirmed at skill_aware_panda_gym/envs/__init__.py:70, the helper is the card's GymnasiumDriver (the upstream is a Gymnasium environment), and no catalogue extension is used, so there are no catalogue requests. The upstream stack (panda-gym, gymnasium, pybullet, numpy, scipy; setup.py:23) was not installed or imported, so the fake backend is the package's own pure Python analytic stand-in for PandaSkillAware-v3 and was never compared with the upstream environment or a PyBullet run; the sim path gym.make('PandaSkillAware-v3') was not run. The fake models the clone's step result (envs/__init__.py:155-166), the get_state thresholds 0.019/0.021/0.21 (envs/__init__.py:141-153), the registration's 50-step TimeLimit (skill_aware_panda_gym/__init__.py:10), the wrapper's 0.05 success threshold and 0.3 sampling ranges (envs/__init__.py:24-27). NOT COVERED: PyBullet rigid-body dynamics, contacts, friction, mass, actuators and sensor noise, rendering, and snapshot/restore (the clone has no get_state/set_state); the fidelity gaps list these. The skill label is reachable as push, pick and roll; down (object at or below 0.019 or above 0.21) is not produced by the analytic stand-in. The action space and the 20 robot+task, 3 achieved-goal and 3 desired-goal observation values are built by panda-gym's external Panda/RobotTaskEnv classes, which are not in this clone: the fake's Box bounds and its 4-value width are test data marked '# placeholder', no Fact or authored Limit cites them, and the served action.values limit (source upstream_code, ref PandaSkillAware-v3:action_space) is the bridge-derived limit of the fake's space, not a claim that the clone states it. observation_space is deliberately not defined on the fake because that name occurs nowhere in the clone and G7 would refuse it; the bridge therefore serves observations as plain objects rather than a published observation schema. Five expected Gymnasium-family warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the seed of the next reset) and G8.NO_UNIT x4 for the bridge-derived inputs (seed twice, ticks and action.values). G7.MAYBE_ABSENT x3 for action_space, reset and close: those names are inherited by PandaPushEnv from panda-gym's RobotTaskEnv/Panda, which the clone's AST cannot follow. No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning was produced, no Limit is operator_required, and there is no site-limits.example.json because the R0 simulated driver has nothing to narrow. gate.digest is the digest line the check printed (the report without its clock); check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run.
